SYNTHESIZED — no real omp transcript was available on this machine.

This fixture mimics the real native record structure of
`<data_dir>/.omp/agent/sessions/<cwd-slug>/<session>.jsonl` as written by
omp (same record shapes as Pi; the reported version is `omp-<runtime.version>`,
here `omp-0.9.1`). omp has no public session-format spec; field names and
types were confirmed against real omp files. Session ids, token counts, and
prose are invented. It is not a captured production transcript.
